Features.label: Features
Features.title: Everything you need for effortless ordering
Features.item1Title: No more waiting for the waiter
Features.item1Text: The guest sees the menu, picks a dish, and places the order themselves — right from their phone, without chasing a waiter mid-shift.
Features.item2Text: Answers from your POS data. Doesn't know something? It says so — "please check with your server" — instead of making it up.
